artefacts.description: Owns financial recognition, books, journals, receivables and payables, reconciliation, period close, approved budgets, allocations and qualified valuation under native or explicitly selected external authority.
Composes selected versioned public HTTP APIs at a secure host boundary without routing internal capability calls through a mandatory network service.
Defines host assembly, trusted context, route ownership, provider binding and public integration without transferring source authority.

Owns reusable assessment instruments, attempts, submissions, marking, moderation, appeals and authoritative assessment-result revisions; does not award qualifications or determine training completion.
Owns managed tangible and intangible asset identity, stewardship, rights and obligation references, custody, assignments, condition and lifecycle; not stock quantities or financial recognition.

Owns activity-scoped participation, invitations and responses, expected rosters, presence observations, verified findings, corrections and authorised disclosure; not reservations, enrolment or specialist outcomes.

Owns governed evidence taxonomy, attributable evidence custody, integrity and completeness assessment, retention, scoped review and qualified attestations; not source business decisions, Logging or Observability.
Proves principal control of authenticators and owns credential, sign-in, session, assurance and revocation lifecycles.
Owns resource-aware access decisions, permission policies, roles, grants and access review; does not authenticate or own protected resources.
Owns commercial charge assessment, credits, billing runs, revisions and disputes independently of invoicing, settlement and recognition.
Owns time-specific reservation intent, holds, confirmation, allocation and release against offered capacity.
Provides provider-neutral derived caching, expiry, invalidation and scope-safe recovery without becoming source authority.
Owns qualified purchase confirmation, submission attempts and recovery, separate from baskets, orders and generic process progression.
Provides deterministic instant, calendar, zone, DST, arithmetic, comparison and formatting semantics plus trusted time-provider interface.
Owns comments, replies, thread structure, comment-specific visibility, enforcement and revision history attached to owner resources.
Owns schema-validated scoped settings, approved changes, effective resolution and provenance without taking over business rules.
Supplies reusable source-owner editing presentation using public contracts, validated rich text and schema-directed controls.
Owns technical content threat assessment requests, qualified scanner findings, limitations and rescanning; source owners retain enforcement.
Owns versioned learning offerings, curricula, intended outcomes, prerequisites and assessment requirements independently of learners.
Owns credential issuance, correction, replacement, expiry, suspension, revocation and verification status for authorised source claims.
Defines declared artefact inventory, compatibility and relationship validation, separate from installation, readiness and authorisation.
Owns legally contextual engagements, contractual terms, changes, absences, establishment capacity and actual occupancy.
Owns learner applications, admission decisions, placement, continuing enrolment, deferrals and withdrawals.
Pure safe error classification, sanitisation and qualified retry advice; callers retain outcome, disclosure and retry decisions.
Owns organised activity definitions and occurrences; generic attendance is independently owned.
Renders validated rich-text trees into supported formats without owning durable export jobs, artefacts or delivery.
Owns operational premises, effective layouts, usable zones, circulation networks and qualified physical passage eligibility.
Coordinates authorised cross-installation peer exchange, subscriptions, checkpoints and withdrawal evidence; no source ownership or transitive trust.
Provides reusable attachment contract and pure validation helpers; callers retain attachment records and Storage owns bytes.
Presents image albums and photo selections using Publisher document types and Media images; owns no independent records.
Composes independent games into a themed portal with catalogue, launch and qualified leaderboard presentation; gameplay remains game-owned.
Supplies accessible version-aware help and contextual assistance; Publisher owns content, independent mapping service remains conditional.
Composes Identity, Authentication, Authorisation and Profile through one secure host entry point without becoming a fifth data owner.
Owns opaque principals, standing, tenants, groups, memberships and digital governance lifecycle.
Defines reproducible environment provisioning, scoped connections, ingress, TLS, UTC synchronisation, backups and recovery; source schemas and data remain owner-controlled.
Coordinates provider-neutral external connections, scoped grants, adapter calls, callbacks, checkpoints and technical reconciliation.
Owns quantity-bearing stock accounts, reservations, committed movements, custody and material genealogy.
Owns issued and received invoice documents, numbering, revisions, delivery, disputes and document-level settlement allocation.
Owns versioned position definitions, duties, grades, skills and qualification requirements, not vacancies or engagements.
Owns qualified legal obligations, applicability, constraint and obligation-to-control mappings; does not enforce another domain's actions.
Owns translation jobs, terminology, contextual risk policy, translation review, provenance and controlled reuse, not routine i18n rendering or source publication.
Owns scoped place references, versioned geometry, spatial relations, provenance and qualified spatial queries, not operational passage rights.
Accepts sanitised structured technical diagnostics, routes to sinks, exposes scoped records and delivery health; not Audit custody.
Owns shipment, despatch, transport legs, routing, carrier assignments, custody observations, delivery evidence and transport exceptions.
Owns outbound email dispatch attempts, transport routing, suppression, retries and qualified provider receipts.
Owns production planning, executable manufacturing BOMs and routings, work orders, operation progress, rework and production-specific cost evidence.
Owns multi-seller venue participation, seller agreements, catalogue submissions, listing decisions, restrictions and marketplace disputes.
Owns secure media intake, metadata, processing, access, derivatives and retirement; file bytes remain Storage-owned. Approved conceptual scope includes supported image, PDF and text formats.
Owns scheme participation, eligibility, membership agreements and lifecycle independently of Identity group membership.
Owns durable transport custody, subscriptions, attempts, acknowledgements and replay of committed source outbox messages; source events remain owner-controlled.
Owns governed terms, taxonomies, ontologies, semantic relationships and opted-in assignments without owning classified source resources.
Owns moderation cases, investigation, decisions, appeals and enforcement reconciliation, not detector verdicts or source resource mutations.
Owns human-attention orchestration, notice intents, policy-qualified audience/channel selection, attempts and optional inbox lifecycle.
Owns technical metrics, traces, monitoring coverage, SLI/SLO evaluation and alert lifecycle; not source business outcomes or incident remediation.
Composes organisational work and optional physical-space views for an office archetype; source owners retain all authoritative facts.
Owns accepted buyer-seller commercial commitments, line snapshots, amendments, cancellation, commercial closure and purchase/sale framework terms.
Presents authorised organisational dashboards and source-directed actions, retaining only presentation descriptors and disposable screen state.
Defines reusable organisational archetypes, position and relationship types, validation and proposed defaults without owning actual appointments or group hierarchy.
Owns page composition schema, component registration, editing and rendering integration; Publisher owns saved pages, templates and lifecycle.
Owns tenant-scoped counterparty references, qualified legal/commercial assertions and correction history, including parties without accounts.
Owns provider-neutral external payment operations, attempts, capture/refund/reversal and qualified execution evidence, not financial recognition or general banking.
Owns pay calculations, approved pay runs, earnings, deductions, liabilities, statements and qualified filing/disbursement evidence under selected authority.
Defines capability-owned schemas, transactions, migrations, outboxes and recovery with host-supplied infrastructure; no independent persistence service.
Owns effective-dated price books, tariffs, adjustments, quotes, promotion budgets and price calculation evidence.
Owns specialist privacy policies, choices, consent where required, disclosure constraints and rights coordination without absorbing source records.
Owns versioned business process definitions, instances, stages, obligations, checkpoints, exceptions and process outcome evidence, not participating domain transactions.
Owns item identities, specifications, variants, units, engineering BOMs, substitutions and revision lifecycle, independently of stock and commercial offers.
Owns personal descriptive records, contact verification, personal preferences and purpose-scoped disclosure, not digital principal or access authority.
Owns project charters, plans, milestones, project acceptance, risk and issue records, forecasts and qualified closure.
Owns registered document publication lifecycle, validated content, immutable versions, revision-bound approval, addresses and safe discovery.
Owns qualification schemes, evidence admissibility, authorised local formal award decisions, appeals, corrections and withdrawal.
Owns inspection plans, tests, findings, non-conformances, technical quality disposition and corrective action evidence.
Owns vacancies, campaigns, applications, evidence-backed selection, offers and independent Employment handover.
Owns report definitions, execution, derived datasets, provenance, schedules, scoped distribution and export status, not source transactions.
Records approved cross-capability allocations for party, payroll, workforce scheduling, budgets, agreements, attendance and accounting.
Owns attributable customer reviews, ratings, revision and publication lifecycle for identified subjects, with independent eligibility and moderation boundaries.
Defines restricted Markdown profiles, deterministic validation and safe structured content trees; owns no content records.
Owns due-time planning, occurrences, worker attempts, leases, retries and reconciliation of source-owned background work.
Owns permission-safe derived indexing, source registration, reconciliation, relevance and bounded query services; source owners retain truth and access decisions.
Owns search-engine projections, indexability policies, sitemap, robots and structured metadata for already approved public resources.
Composes product discovery, basket, checkout and customer or seller journeys without owning commerce records.
Owns persistent non-binding purchase intent, guest claim and merge, selected lines, revisions and checkout correlation.
Owns verified hostname claims, site bindings, aliases, primary host and trusted resolution; Infrastructure owns hosting operations.
Owns server-controlled file-byte custody, staged transfer, integrity, scoped delivery, copy and deletion; consumers own file business records and rights.
Owns recurring agreements, plan benefits, lifecycle, entitlement decisions and contractual seat or usage limits.
Owns accountable work, assignments, deadlines, progress, completion evidence, verification and attributable history.
Deterministically parses, validates and expands templates against explicit caller-supplied data and schemas; no template records or live data lookup.
Adapts Temporal SDK connections, workers, execution receipts and reconciliation through provider-neutral host ports; owns no business schedules, events or approvals.
Owns theme definitions, semantic tokens, validation, selection, effective-theme resolution and fallback, separate from generic settings and host routes.
Owns attributable actual-work observations, breaks, timesheets, approved time statements, disputes and corrections.
Composes lightweight personal/shared work-intention collections with minimal native state; linked Task records remain Task-owned.
Owns educational participation, learning evidence, competency findings and programme completion decisions and corrections.
Supplies generic accessible localisable presentation components and safe rich-text rendering without business state.
Presents group-scoped people, memberships, invitations and access summaries through IAM contracts; owns transient UI state only.
Generates and validates standards-compliant UUIDs including UUIDv7; callers own uniqueness and entity allocation.
Owns evidence challenges, scoped issuer trust evaluation, qualified findings, rechecks and attestation lifecycle without owning external facts or permissions.
Owns physical receiving, put-away, picking, packing, staging, counting and handover work, observations and discrepancy evidence.
Owns human approval routes, cases, assignments, delegation, quorum, decisions and qualified approval outcomes; source owners retain final business decisions.
Owns planned shifts, rosters, availability, assignment offers, coverage, conflicts and published revisions, not actual work or pay.
